We employ eight datasets across various NLP tasks to evaluate the impact of bit-flip errors on model performance: MRPC (paraphrase detection) , MNLI (natural language inference) , SST-2 (sentiment classification) , CoLA (linguistic acceptability) , MMLU (multi-task language understanding) , ARC-E (science question answering) , Wikitext-103 (language modeling, text generation) , SQuAD (question answering) (Rajpurkar, 2016), and GSM8K (math problem solving) .
